findings.title: The DEEP-RESEARCH publication branch cannot take its declared canonical exits under the closed canonical guards
findings.requirement: The incorporated manifest says each row is a closed edge, every intermediate canonical guard is rechecked, and no prose or inferred pair adds an edge. The publication path therefore needs an executable verified-success exit and a deterministic proven-no-application exit using the exact canonical guards.
evidence: docs/state-transition-manifests.md:7 and 20 require every listed intermediate guard to be rechecked and define each table row as closed.
docs/state-transition-manifests.md:40-43 define CW14 MERGE_QUEUED->MERGED under verified-effect and CW16 MERGED->OBSERVING under the separate no-deploy-receipt guard.

docs/state-transition-manifests.md:342 makes D19P3 take MERGE_QUEUED>MERGED>OBSERVING with only a verified publication-effect receipt and remote identity. It names no no-deploy receipt, so the second edge's CW16 guard is not supplied by the closed row.
docs/state-transition-manifests.md:345 has the same missing CW16 guard after D19P6 reconciliation.

docs/state-transition-manifests.md:39 defines CW12 MERGE_QUEUED->REVIEW only for a head-or-check change, but line 344 makes D19P5 use MERGE_QUEUED>REVIEW>CLEANING on signed absence/no-application plus retry forbidden/exhausted. That condition is not a head-or-check change. No other non-cancel row leaves PUBLICATION_DISPATCHED after proven absence.

docs/state-transition-manifests.md:861 publishes D19P3 as a receipt-only successful witness, while PLAN.md:395 likewise states that a real verified publication receipt is sufficient to cross MERGED and that either publication branch later cleans. Neither contract supplies the distinct CW16 receipt or repairs the illegal D19P5 first edge.
reproduction: Reach PUBLICATION_QUEUED via D19P1 and PUBLICATION_DISPATCHED via D19P2. On a verified publication effect, apply D19P3. CW14 is enabled, but after MERGED the required CW16 no-deploy-receipt is not among D19P3's exact guard/receipts, so the atomic sequence rejects or requires an unmodeled receipt.

Instead reconcile a no-application result and exhaust or forbid retry. D19P5 asks for MERGE_QUEUED->REVIEW, but CW12 enables that edge only on a head/check change. With no such unrelated change, D19P5 rejects and PUBLICATION_DISPATCHED has no non-cancel settled-failure exit.
The no-publication trace D19 then D19C1 does not have this defect; the issue is isolated to the requested publication branch.
findings.impact: A write-enabled research run can remain stuck after a proven no-application result, and even verified publication cannot complete its declared atomic projection without inventing a receipt outside the closed row. This contradicts the normative total-path contract and leaves the publication implementation path undefined.
findings.recommendation: For D19P3 and D19P6, bind and verify an explicit protected NoDeploymentReceipt (or add a purpose-specific legal canonical edge whose guard is exactly the publication outcome). For D19P5, add a legal effect-failure route such as an explicitly guarded MERGE_QUEUED>BLOCKED>CLEANING sequence with the saved-continuation and final-disposition predicates, or add a purpose-specific canonical no-application edge. Update the research tuple witnesses to instantiate and check every intermediate guard, not adjacency alone.
findings.verification: Replay D19P1/P2 followed by (a) verified application, (b) reconciled verified application, and (c) proven no-application/no-retry. Each trace must satisfy every intermediate canonical guard using fields named by the closed row, must enter cleanup only in a later transaction where promised, and must have no unrelated head/check-change dependency.

residual_uncertainty: This plan-only audit does not prove implementation, full reachable-product model checking, operational safety, external source truth, or semantic entailment.
